description: Piece together the FUN in Microsoft Jigsaw! Discover hundreds of puzzles across three (3) winning game modes: Classic, Jigsaw Jam, & Daily Challenges.   Pick a favorite puzzle, create your own, or unlock NEW puzzle collections as you play. Find relaxation and joy as you exercise your mind.  Classic Jigsaw: Complete traditional jigsaw puzzles with endless themes and images to choose from. Select the number of pieces to make it easy, moderate or difficult. Zoom-in, auto-arrange, or use special in-game trays to get organized. If you enjoy real jigsaw puzzling, Classic Mode is the experience...
